title: Do not override chat_streaming_to_model on the Vertex Claude adapter
answers: Vertex Claude streaming payload applies anthropic_version twice
Double application of Vertex fields in chat_streaming_to_model
body:
Invariant: _VertexAIClaudeAdapter (mlflow/gateway/providers/vertex_ai.py) must override only chat_to_model, not chat_streaming_to_model.
Enforced by: AnthropicAdapter.chat_streaming_to_model (mlflow/gateway/providers/anthropic.py) delegates to cls.chat_to_model, so the inherited streaming method already gets the Vertex fields via the override.
What breaks if skipped: a second override applies the transformation twice. The current _apply_vertex_fields is idempotent, so output stays correct, but the redundant pass becomes a bug if the transform ever stops being idempotent (review comment on this PR).
If a new Anthropic-family adapter needs streaming-only changes, check first whether the base streaming method already calls chat_to_model.
applies: Subclasses of AnthropicAdapter and any adapter overriding chat_to_model/chat_streaming_to_model.
says: Streaming chat requests to Claude on Google Cloud apply parameters twice during execution.
Why are request payload fields duplicated when streaming chat completions through Vertex AI?
Claude streaming responses on Vertex AI perform redundant request transformations before forwarding.
Ensure streaming chat completions for Claude on Vertex AI transform request parameters only once.
Prevent duplicated provider payload fields when streaming chat interactions through the gateway.
search: The Vertex AI Claude adapter must override only chat_to_model and not chat_streaming_to_model because the base Anthropic adapter delegates streaming calls to chat_to_model. In mlflow/gateway/providers/vertex_ai.py:_VertexAIClaudeAdapter, an unnecessary override of chat_streaming_to_model causes transformations from _apply_vertex_fields to execute twice. Although _apply_vertex_fields is currently idempotent, avoiding duplicate execution prevents defects if the transform logic changes in the future. This rule applies to subclasses of AnthropicAdapter in mlflow/gateway/providers/anthropic.py, requiring developers creating Anthropic-family adapters to verify whether base streaming methods delegate to chat_to_model before adding overrides.
